enterpriseLicenses.title: Enterprise Licenses

userView.title: User

userView.masterAdminSwitchOffDescription: Access only to the projects this user is a member of.

userView.masterAdminRevokeConfirmDescription: They will lose access to this Admin Dashboard. The projects they are a member of stay as they are.

userView.masterAdminRevokeOwnConfirmDescription: This is your own account. You will lose access to this Admin Dashboard, and only another master admin can give it back.
